items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and retain parked dispositions. Rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete; external outreach stays unsent pending human-counsel review. Continue the existing consolidated evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix.

Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize data are not established; all four legal tasks remain open; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment; smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures; smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookies, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch. Do not expose or monetize before completion.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth on sites with existing evidence; evidence_needed or blocked for public or rights-dependent launches. Compliance is a technical baseline only, with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; failures and unknowns require site-specific evidence or remediation. Analytics is generally configured and healthy where reported, but source permissions or collector errors remain yellow; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable, so revenue, ROI, margin, payback, and causal claims remain unsupported. Do not create new proposals, telemetry, monetization, deployments, spend, or queue work this cycle.
